Lesson 12: A Hospital Window
Keywords : vivid, overlook, view, skyline, in detail
Read aloud the story about a hospital window and think about the
Two sick men were given the same room in a hospital. One man could sit up
in his bed. His bed was next to the room’s only window. The other man
spent all his time lying on his bed opposite the window. The men talked
for hours almost every day. They talked about their wives, children,
homes, their jobs and almost about everything.
